Local BEM supplement to the published ScIce-2025 column table.
Column_BEM: five direct matched-geometry calculations, ka=20,25,30,35,40.
Column_ScIce_plus_BEM: published rows plus BEM rows, distinguished by method.
Original published table is unchanged. NPZ files contain full-angle Mueller matrices, not T matrices.
M11/M22 and Cext: um^2/sr and um^2, respectively; S11/S22 are dimensionless.
DR=(M11-M22)/(M11+M22); L is particle height, T_order is the modal cutoff.
See provenance.json for geometry, hashes, tolerances and source directories.
